manifest.name: dsh-pi-ai-patch
manifest.description: DSH 插件：把 cordis.patch.yml 里模型条目的 input 模态声明做成设置面板里的勾选框（写入/移除 input: [text, image]），省掉手改 YAML 的缩进风险。只改 DSH 侧声明，不改 API 能力。

readme.text:
> 在 DSH 设置里一行勾选，直接往 `cordis.patch.yml` 的模型声明里写 `input: [text, image]`（或 `[text]`）。
>
> 一个 **`cordis.patch.yml` 的可视化配置模板工具**：不改 API 能力，只改 DSH 侧的模型声明。

自建网关、第三方中转、任何兼容 OpenAI / Anthropic 协议的端点，在 DSH 里手写在 `cordis.patch.yml` 中的 provider 模型**默认没有 `input` 字段**。插件把这个字段变成面板上的勾选框，省掉翻几百行 YAML 改缩进。

**它做的事只有一件**：往你指定的模型下写入或移除

```yaml
input:
  - text
  - image
```

**它不做的事**：它不会给 API 增加任何能力，不会改写请求内容，不会碰网络。

这个字段在 `@WorkBuddy-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` 里就是模型的**模态声明**：`DEFAULT_INPUT = ["text"]`，没写 `input` 的模型按纯文本对待。所以勾上之后的实际效果是——DSH 认为该模型可以收图，于是**本地的拦截不再触发**，你上传的图片会被打包进请求真正发到你的端点。

图片到了你的 API 之后能不能被看懂，取决于**你的 API**。声明与实际不符时，报错会从 DSH 本地（`does not support image input`）变成上游返回的错误。请按你的端点实际情况勾选。

- 🖱️ **一个勾选框搞定**：设置 → 识图配置，按 provider 分组列出所有模型，勾选即写入、取消即移除
- 🛡️ **不会把你的配置改坏**：行级、字节安全编辑，保留你的注释、键顺序与引号风格；写入前先做 YAML 校验，解析不过就放弃写入
- 💾 **自动备份**：每次保存前备份为 `cordis.patch.yml.bak-vision-config`
- 🔒 **只在本机回环**：HTTP 服务只监听 `127.0.0.1:19877`
- 🧩 **不依赖 DSH 私有 API**：客户端走 `settings.section` + `fetch`，DSH 小版本升级一般不会把它打挂
```powershell
git clone https://github.com/<you>/dsh-pi-ai-patch.git C:\dsh-pi-ai-patch

只有这三行：

```yaml
models:
  - id: gpt-4o
    name: GPT-4o
    contextWindow: 128000

其余一切——注释、键顺序、引号、BOM、换行符——原样不动。

> Tick a box in DSH settings to write `input: [text, image]` (or `[text]`) straight into your `cordis.patch.yml` model declarations.
>
> A **visual template editor for `cordis.patch.yml`**. It edits DSH-side model declarations. It does not add any capability to your API.

Providers you hand-write in `cordis.patch.yml` — self-hosted gateways, third-party relays, anything speaking OpenAI / Anthropic protocols — have **no `input` field**. This plugin turns that field into a checkbox so you don't have to hand-edit hundreds of lines of YAML and count spaces.

readme.section: What it does, and what it does not
readme.text:
**The only thing it does** is write or remove, under the model you pick:

```yaml
input:
  - text
  - image
```

**What it does not do**: it does not give your API any new capability, does not rewrite requests, does not touch the network.

readme.section: What it does, and what it does not
readme.text: In `@WorkBuddy-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` this field is the model's **modality declaration**: `DEFAULT_INPUT = ["text"]`, and models without `input` are treated as text-only. So the real effect of ticking the box is that DSH **stops blocking image messages locally** and packs your uploaded image into the outgoing request to your endpoint.

readme.section: What it does, and what it does not
readme.text: Whether your API can actually read that image is up to your API. When the declaration and the endpoint disagree, the error moves from DSH's local `does not support image input` to whatever your upstream returns. Tick according to what your endpoint really does.

- 🖱️ **One checkbox**: Settings → Vision Config lists every model grouped by provider; tick to add, untick to remove
- 🛡️ **Will not break your config**: line-based, byte-safe editing keeps your comments, key order and quoting; YAML is validated before writing, and nothing is written if parsing fails
- 💾 **Automatic backup**: saved to `cordis.patch.yml.bak-vision-config` before every write
- 🔒 **Loopback only**: the HTTP server binds `127.0.0.1:19877`
- 🧩 **No DSH-private API**: the client uses `settings.section` + `fetch`, so minor DSH upgrades generally won't break it

1. Put this repo somewhere, e.g. `C:\dsh-pi-ai-patch`.

2. Register it in your profile (`~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json`):

```json
   "dsh-pi-ai-patch": "link:C:/dsh-pi-ai-patch"
   ```

and append `"dsh-pi-ai-patch"` to `dsh.profile.bundles`.

3. Install the single dependency:

```powershell
   cd C:\dsh-pi-ai-patch
   npm install --omit=dev
   ```

4. Fully quit DSH and start it again.

5. Open **Settings → Vision Config**, tick models according to your endpoint, save, restart DSH.

DSH's `llm-pi-ai` plugin reads provider and model definitions from `cordis.patch.yml`. The `input` array on a model entry is what decides whether DSH lets images through:

```yaml
- id: llm-pi-ai
  name: "@WorkBuddy-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai"
  config:
    providers:

The plugin stays deliberately small:
- **Client side** (`client.js`) registers a `settings.section` and talks to the host over `fetch`, using **no DSH-private API**, so minor DSH upgrades generally won't break it.

readme.section: Why not let DSH decide on its own
readme.text:
Because upstream DSH cannot know whether *your* gateway accepts images for *that* model. Letting the user declare it is more reliable than guessing.

Relevant source (`@WorkBuddy-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai/lib/index.js`):

readme.section: Why not let DSH decide on its own
readme.text:
```js
const DEFAULT_INPUT = ["text"];                                   // :972
input: declaredInput(entry.input) ?? base?.input ?? [...request.defaultInput],  // :705
if (containsImage && !model.input.includes("image"))
  throw new LlmError(`pi-ai model "${model.id}" does not support image input`, "UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT");  // :1961

Only bound to `127.0.0.1`, never exposed externally.

| Method | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/vision/status` | All providers / models with their `image` declaration, plus the target file path |
| POST | `/vision/toggle` | Body `{ "provider": "my-gateway", "model": "gpt-4o", "vision": true }` |
| POST | `/vision/backup` | Back up the current `cordis.patch.yml` |
The target file defaults to `<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` and can be overridden with the `DSH_YML` environment variable (handy for testing).

- **Port**: fixed at `19877`. If it is taken, the server fails to start and logs it; DSH itself still boots. Change `PORT` in `index.js` and `VISION_BASE` in `client.js` to move it.
- **Restart required**: provider config is loaded at startup, so a restart is needed before changes take effect.
- **Scope**: it only edits `cordis.patch.yml`. It never touches `package.json`, `node_modules` or other `.dsh` state.
- Ticking is a **declaration**, not a guarantee. If your endpoint does not really accept images, the error simply moves upstream.
- The panel only walks the `llm-pi-ai` section. Using a different llm plugin? Adjust `findModelIdx` in `index.js`.
```powershell

readme.section: Run against a throwaway config instead of your real profile
readme.text:
$env:DSH_YML = "C:\path\to\test.patch.yml"
node index.js

curl http://127.0.0.1:19877/vision/status
```

`index.js` exports `readDoc / addInput / removeInput / scan / persist / findModelIdx` for tests.
